keySentence: Every dangerous adventure teaches what safety at home cannot.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim is home now. He learned about courage and trust. The adventure changed him forever. Every dangerous adventure teaches what safety at home cannot.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim returned home and went back to his normal life. But inside, he carried the memories of his incredible adventure. He learned about courage, trust, wisdom, and the danger of greed. The real treasure was not gold but the person Jim became. Every dangerous adventure teaches what safety at home cannot. Next week, a brand new adventure begins!
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Jim finally returned to his quiet life at the inn, but nothing felt quite the same. The memories of Treasure Island — the battles, the betrayals, the friendships — lived on in his heart. He had learned that true courage means acting despite fear, not without it. He understood that trust is precious and must be earned through consistent actions. Every dangerous adventure teaches what safety at home cannot. However, perhaps the greatest lesson was that greed destroys while generosity builds. Because Jim experienced all of this firsthand, these lessons became part of who he was forever. As one adventure ended, Jim knew that life itself is the greatest adventure of all.
